BiblicalUsage: Sibbecai is the Hushathite who kills Saph, one of the giants of the Philistines, in the battle at Gob. His name appears in the list of David's mighty men and in the account of the giant wars. He is a warrior remembered for a single killing that mattered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sibbecai shows that God gives ordinary warriors extraordinary victories, and one giant falls at a time.
RelatedEvents: David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
